scan.message: The NCCP protocol register is ready. The first source comparison will establish the current review baseline.

features.title: New protocol detection
features.function: Identifies an NCCP regimen that appears in the published catalogue but is not yet represented in SACTCheck.
features.strength: Makes newly published treatment sources visible for review instead of relying on occasional manual catalogue checks.

features.title: Updated protocol detection
features.function: Identifies when a registered NCCP protocol has changed since the source was last reviewed.
features.strength: Gives clinicians a clear signal that the current SACTCheck encoding may require reconciliation against newer protocol content.

features.title: Unannounced source change detection
features.function: Identifies a change in published protocol content even when the visible version label or source address appears unchanged.
features.strength: Reduces the chance that an unnoticed document change leaves an encoded assessment linked to an older interpretation.

features.title: Removed or moved protocol detection
features.function: Identifies when a previously registered NCCP source is no longer present in its expected catalogue location.
features.strength: Prompts review of whether a regimen was retired, moved, renamed or temporarily unavailable before its SACTCheck status changes.

features.title: Clinical significance triage
features.function: Groups detected changes into treatment criteria, safety workflow, information or presentation categories.
features.strength: Helps reviewers prioritise possible dose, schedule, eligibility, laboratory and toxicity changes while retaining clinical confirmation.

features.title: Previous and current source comparison
features.function: Presents the earlier and current protocol content together and directs the reviewer to the relevant changed passages.
features.strength: Creates a faster and more transparent review pathway than rereading two complete protocol documents without guidance.

features.title: Mandatory human review gate
features.function: Prevents a detected source change from automatically rewriting any clinical rule or treatment action.
features.strength: Keeps clinical interpretation, approval and release control with authorised reviewers.

features.title: Change history and source provenance
features.function: Records the source version, detection date, review state and SACTCheck release that incorporates an approved change.
features.strength: Provides a visible maintenance trail for governance, validation and future external review.

required_sequence: Preserve the previous and current source
Update encoded content only after approval
